prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Adding wait-step status indicators (+14.7% measured) and diagnostic screens (+6.1% measured) were helpful; predictions (+14.0% and +3.5%) were slightly too low.
Deferring account sign-in significantly harmed performance (-7.3%), and the prediction (+15.0%) was far too high.
Path outcome copy optimization significantly harmed performance (-6.6%), while other copy refinements showed no clear effect; predictions were generally too high.
Hints, callouts, redesigns, and layout changes showed no clear effect, even when metrics leaned positive; predictions (+1.0% to +12.0%) were consistently too high.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, layout: +3.2% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, wait_info: +14.7% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: -3.4% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -2.0% over 1 test(s)
- finish, hint: +2.1% over 1 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: +8.6% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: +8.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, hint: +0.7% over 1 test(s)
- home, new_screen: +6.1% over 1 test(s)
- home, redesign: +4.1% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -2.5% over 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 87.0%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, new_screen] Desktop Render Test Screen: Adds a dedicated desktop rendering test screen right after waiting to verify that the pet sprite is rendering properly on the user's primary monitor before completing setup. (why: 3 support emails reported that the pet does not show on the desktop or the app fails to open, while waiting time averages over 2300 seconds.)
1: [home, notification] Background Task Notification Toggle for Generation: Enables desktop system notification prompts on the waiting screen so users receive a desktop alert when pet generation completes. (why: Waiting on the home step has a long mean time of 2336s, causing drop-off while users wait passively.)
2: [adoption, wait_info] Photo Quality Validation Checklist: Displays a visible requirement checklist on the photo upload screen covering lighting, resolution, and single-subject framing. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failing or looking distorted due to poor photo inputs.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Existing Pet Account Sync Banner: Adds explicit sign-in banner copy clarifying that logging in syncs and restores existing pets without data loss. (why: 8 support emails (the top issue) reported pets missing or resetting after signing back in.)
4: [choose_path, new_screen] Pet Companion Teaser Intro Screen: Adds a short visual teaser screen before path selection showcasing animated desktop pet interactions and taskbar behaviors. (why: Path selection takes a high mean time of 514s and loses 23.8% of users immediately after entry.)
5: [finish, hint] System Tray Quick Action Callout Tip: Adds a tip carousel callout on the final screen explaining right-clicking system tray icons to hide, summon, or talk to the pet. (why: 3 support tickets noted confusion on how to control or hide the pet once setup finishes.)

scores.note: Diagnostic screens on the home step have a strong track record of success (+6.1%).
Wait-step status and alert indicators have proven highly effective (+14.7%) for long wait steps.
Adding clear requirements/validation during adoption wait steps aligns with top-performing historical changes.
Top support issue, but pure copy changes consistently underperform predictions and offer minimal step lift.
Target step loses many users, but adding additional screens and friction to path selection historically harms conversion.
Addresses major drop step and user confusion, but hint/callout changes historically yield only minor positive effects.
